intent: Independently review the local runtime history integration and distinguish source correctness from live authorization evidence.
reviewer: /root/history_refinement_audit; did not author implementation or tests
verdict: clear source review; live saved-room request verification remains unperformed
verified_by_source_inspection: Ordinary tutor suggestion generation explicitly opts into complete output history; existing common context callers retain posted-text behavior.
Feedback is filtered to room and accepted/modified actions, then matched to a saved ordinary tutor message and the same tutor identity.
Rejected, ignored, unlinked, wrong-tutor and learner-attributed feedback cannot become delivered tutor history.
Complete prior reason/decision/response is reconstructed through the existing response parser. Missing historical metadata stays posted text; incomplete metadata is not fabricated.
Human wording edits and mode rectification are labelled separately from the original generated output. Public message content is unchanged.
Feedback pagination uses chronological/id cursor and explicit read-error propagation. Duplicate linked output records fail explicitly rather than choosing an arbitrary one.
Assessment and persona-specific messages retain their specialized context behavior.
The existing tutor membership path already reads the same feedback table/fields, so no new database schema is implied by this change.

The integration tests exercise final history serialization, modified delivery, default context isolation, attribution, unused/manual/legacy rows, later pages, long reason preservation, read failure and duplicates.
The helper now follows the project's commented shebang convention for imported TypeScript.

verification_evidence_boundary.reported_by_implementation_agent: Five focused suites passed 70 tests; served localhost bundle contains formatter and no prior reason cap. Full tsc has pre-existing errors, no diagnostics in changed runtime files or new integration test.
verification_evidence_boundary.independently_performed_here: Source and test inspection plus exact prompt-request parity check; no duplicate test rerun or live database/browser call.
verification_evidence_boundary.not_established: Actual current-user feedback read authorization and complete saved-room request replay. Existing query use and mocked tests do not prove live access.

report_review: Draft report's independent totals match the 72-output review and keep limited coverage explicit. Requested wording refinement avoids claiming a causal benefit or harm from carrying prior mistaken rationale; the two factors remain bundled.
